summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by DRDGOLD Limited, a South African gold mining company, announcing the availability of an investor presentation to be delivered at the 121 Investment Conference in New York. The filing contains no transaction, no material corporate action, and no special situation such as M&A, restructuring, or capital return. It is merely a notice of an upcoming investor conference and a link to the presentation. As a standard current report from a foreign private issuer with no event-driven content, it falls outside the scope of special-situations categories.
